QF.id: AIF Valuation Taxation and Good Practices_63

question.text: GST on management fees is borne by:

answer.text: The fund (and indirectly investors), charged over and above the management fee

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the AIF (Category I and II) Distributors workbook (p. 52), management fees are payable by the fund to the investment manager. GST is applicable on the management fee and is usually charged over and above the management fee, so the GST cost is borne by the fund and indirectly by the investors who fund the management fee through the AIF. The Trap: SEBI is the regulator, not a payer of GST on fund-level management fees. The government collects GST, it does not bear it. Investee companies pay GST on their own expenses, not on the AIF's management fee. Note: The source explicitly states on p. 52 that GST on the management fee is usually charged extra, on top of the negotiated management fee paid by the fund to the investment manager.
